theme: He Shall Supply All Your Need
verse: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verse_spoken: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning as my provider.
Thank you for every good thing you have already placed in my hands.
You know every bill, every need, and every worry I carry today.
I lay them down before you and choose to trust your supply.
Provide for my home, my family, and the work of my hands.
Open doors of opportunity and give me wisdom to steward what you give.
Where there is lack, let your riches in glory meet me there.
Make me generous, so I can be a blessing to others in need.
Provide for everyone praying with me today, and let us see your faithfulness.
